The present paper reproduces that theorem and proof in full as part of the support-size phase transition, thereby absorbing the earlier manuscript; the two manuscripts will not be submitted in parallel, and the present paper is the sole intended external version of the overlapping material.

items.statement: No positive-characteristic analogue is claimed.
PC1 does not allow c=0, a=0, or a zero displayed b_j.
Repeated exponents and zero coefficients are collected or deleted before support size is counted.
Support size and the theorem are not claimed affine-conjugacy invariant.
The unit-equation, sparse-image, component, and cardinality constants are not claimed optimal.
No effective enumeration algorithm for T_2 or T_4 is claimed.
No height estimate is claimed.
No classification of periodic points, rational periodic points, or integral cycles is claimed.
No classification of every coefficient stratum with an infinite shorter window is claimed.
No theorem for arbitrary rational maps, arbitrary polynomial automorphisms, arbitrary Hénon compositions, or arbitrary normal forms is claimed.
Finite rank is not replaced by arbitrary subgroup scope.
Finite rank is not silently replaced by finite generation.
No coefficient is assumed to belong to Gamma.
No closure of Gamma under addition is assumed or claimed.
The bounded literature search is not an absolute priority, first-result, or absence-of-unpublished-work statement.
Bell--Ghioca's finite residual is not finiteness of the whole hitting-time set, and the Hénon torus restriction is not declared regular.
Ji--Xie--Zhang non-density is not turned into finiteness or a cardinality bound.
The two incompatible Mello--Yasufuku epsilon regimes are not merged into an unconditional theorem.
The restricted Kim et al. constructions are not turned into universal rational or integral periodic-point bounds.
No code, CAS, computation, scan, experiment, data, or numerical check is theorem evidence.
PC3 receives no separate renewed novelty claim and is not a black-box citation to the earlier manuscript.

items: Define H, its inverse, actual collected support, finite rank without finite generation, and T_m as m transitions and m+1 states.
Prove the sparse-image lemma with a rank-2r tuple group, A(q,2r), a degree-d power fiber, all 2^q-q-2 proper degenerate subsets, and arbitrary torsion.
Normalize the first recurrence with Z=z/c, U=-au/c, and M_j=-b_j*v^(e_j)/c; derive the rank-3r nondegenerate contribution d*A(s+2,3r).
Derive the exhaustive GZ, GU, R0, and R1 incidence types without assuming disjointness.
Close GZ and GU at J=[s] and |J|=1 using a multi-term sparse side and fixed coefficient cosets.
Derive R0 degree e_maxJ-e_minJ and R1 degree e_maxJ, then close each vertical fiber even when c+a*rho=0.
Overcount simultaneous zero subsums safely and derive M(e) from its two subset sums, with both checksum proofs.
Prove PC2 and the exact c=0 and a=0 counterexamples by direct substitution.
Reproduce the A/B/C labels, all nine adjacent transitions, BA and CB closure, the compatible CBA branch, and the 81*d^2 word union.
Audit both rank-one sharpness families and synthesize the exact s=1 versus s>=2 phase transition.
